{{Quote|Did you know Fara here was a warrior chieftain? Maybe he's never fired a blaster or been aboard a Star Destroyer, but he got to be a chieftain ''somehow''. Doesn't that suggest he has something to contribute.|Shea Hublin, to Kaal|<ref name="The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai (short story)">{{InsiderCite|132|The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai (short story)}}</ref>}}
'''Fara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kelrodoan]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kelrodo-Ai/Legends|Kelrodo-Ai]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and he eventually became a warrior chieftain amongst his people. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Kelrodo-Ai became the site of a [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai|battle]] between the Empire and [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdout]] forces, and Fara was assigned to act as a groom to the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the Empire's [[Sword Squadron (Imperial)|Sword Squadron]], who had been dispatched to fight on the world. While the pilot [[Kaal (individual)|Kaal]] took a dislike to the Kelrodoan, [[Shea Hublin]], the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron's]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], respected the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] and struck up a friendship with Fara.
